name: GhostSelect
description: Themed GhostSelect trigger and listbox surfaces using semantic --ghost-* tokens.

parts.name: trigger
parts.description: ghost-select-trigger surface aligned to control tokens.

parts.name: value
parts.description: Selected label or placeholder; fills the trigger and ends long labels with an ellipsis.

parts.name: content
parts.description: Elevated listbox panel, capped to the viewport width.

states.name: placeholder
states.description: Muted value text while nothing is selected.

states.name: invalid
states.description: Danger border when the trigger has aria-invalid, from the root or a GhostField.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Disabled action tokens on the trigger; disabled options are muted.

states.name: open
states.description: Focus ring on the trigger while the listbox is open; also shown on keyboard focus.

states.name: checked
states.description: Muted fill and medium weight on the selected option.
